# Real programs for the compatibility suite (test/compat), built by the
# Makefile from their own sources: Lua, QuickJS and the sqlite3 shell.
# The format is applets.txt's:
#
#   == NAME
#   $ COMMAND        (one line, run by ash in /)
#   expected output, line by line, compared exactly
#
# Keep files a case makes under names starting with "ca_" and remove them
# in the same command.

== lua: arithmetic and strings
$ /disk/lua -e 'print(_VERSION, 2^10, 7 // 2, string.format("%5.2f|%x", math.pi, 255))'
Lua 5.4	1024.0	3	 3.14|ff

== lua: files
$ /disk/lua -e 'local f = io.open("ca_l", "w"); f:write("one\ntwo\n"); f:close(); for l in io.lines("ca_l") do io.write(l, ";") end; print(os.remove("ca_l"))'
one;two;true

== lua: popen and os.execute
$ /disk/lua -e 'print(io.popen("echo piped"):read("l")); print(os.execute("exit 3"))'
piped
nil	exit	3

== lua: coroutines and tables
$ /disk/lua -e 'local c = coroutine.wrap(function() for i = 1, 3 do coroutine.yield(i * i) end end); local t = {}; for i = 1, 3 do t[i] = c() end; table.sort(t, function(a, b) return a > b end); print(table.concat(t, ","))'
9,4,1

== qjs: language
$ /disk/qjs -e 'class P { #x = 2; get x() { return this.#x } }; console.log([1, 2, 3].map(v => v * new P().x).join(","), 2n ** 70n, JSON.stringify({a: [1, {b: null}]}))'
2,4,6 1180591620717411303424n {"a":[1,{"b":null}]}

== qjs: promises and timers
$ /disk/qjs --std -e 'Promise.resolve(1).then(v => console.log("then", v)); os.setTimeout(() => console.log("timer"), 50); console.log("sync")'
sync
then 1
timer

== qjs: files and exec
$ /disk/qjs --std -e 'let f = std.open("ca_q", "w"); f.puts("hello\n"); f.close(); console.log(std.loadFile("ca_q").trim(), os.exec(["/bin/sh", "-c", "exit 5"]), os.remove("ca_q"))'
hello 5 0

== sqlite3: in memory
$ /disk/sqlite3 -list :memory: 'create table t(a, b); insert into t values (1, "x"), (2, "y"); select sum(a), group_concat(b) from t;'
3|x,y

== sqlite3: a database file
$ /disk/sqlite3 -list ca_s.db 'create table t(a); insert into t values (42);' && /disk/sqlite3 -list ca_s.db 'select a from t; pragma integrity_check;'; rm -f ca_s.db
42
ok

== sqlite3: WAL
$ /disk/sqlite3 -list ca_w.db 'pragma journal_mode = wal; create table t(a); insert into t values (7); select a from t;'; rm -f ca_w.db ca_w.db-wal ca_w.db-shm
wal
7

== sqlite3: 20000 rows, an index and a query
$ /disk/sqlite3 -list ca_b.db 'create table t(a, b); with recursive c(x) as (select 1 union all select x + 1 from c where x < 20000) insert into t select x, x % 97 from c; create index i on t(b); select count(*), count(distinct b), sum(a) from t where b = 5;'; rm -f ca_b.db
207|1|2069172

== ash: a 1200-byte typed line
$ echo  | /disk/busybox wc -c
1201
